newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide in 5 year pact with ITT In.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide in 5 year pact with ITT In.

text.p: Express freight carrier Emery Worldwide said it has been awarded a five-year contract as ITT Industries' preferred air freight carrier for North American shipments over 10 lbs.
Emery said this is the first time ITT has awarded a single source transportation contract.

Emery said 65 percent of ITT's North American air freight business is related to the automotive industry and primarily involves inbound shipments from suppliers and among production facilities in the states of New York, North Carolina and Mexico. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
